3️⃣ Nemotron-CC-Math

High-quality reasoning starts with high-quality data.

Nemotron-CC-Math is a 133B-token math-focused pretraining dataset, carefully curated for diversity, correctness, and scale — designed to support reasoning during pretraining.

🤗Dataset: https://t.co/AfpyhtvJtM
📄 Paper: https://t.co/6sNF6k2fPC
Huge thanks to all the collaborators @KarimiRabeeh @issanjeev @MostofaPatwary @MohammadShoeybi @ctnzr !!

tweets.title:
2️⃣ Front-Loading Reasoning

When should reasoning data be introduced — pretraining or post-training?

Our answer: earlier is better. We show that front-loading
tweets.body:
2️⃣ Front-Loading Reasoning

When should reasoning data be introduced — pretraining or post-training?

Our answer: earlier is better. We show that front-loading diverse reasoning data during pretraining creates durable reasoning capabilities that later SFT cannot fully recover, even with more data.
📄 Paper: https://t.co/b9ixkRKmqR
Huge thanks to all the collaborators @__SyedaAkter Eric Nyberg, @MostofaPatwary @MohammadShoeybi @YejinChoinka @ctnzr !!

tweets.title:
1️⃣ RLP: Reinforcement as a Pretraining Objective

Reinforcement learning is usually saved for post-training.
🚀RLP flips that script.
We introduce an informatio
tweets.body:
1️⃣ RLP: Reinforcement as a Pretraining Objective

Reinforcement learning is usually saved for post-training.
🚀RLP flips that script.
We introduce an information-driven reinforcement objective during pretraining, encouraging models to explore chain-of-thought as an action and teaching models how to think before fine-tuning.

📄 Paper: https://t.co/y51qJ8rkcH
Huge thanks to the collaborators @ahatamiz1 @__SyedaAkter @jankautz @MostofaPatwary @MohammadShoeybi @ctnzr @YejinChoinka !! 🎉

tweets.body:
Thrilled to share that all three of our papers were accepted to @iclr_conf   🎉

1⃣RLP: Reinforcement as a Pretraining Objective
2⃣Front-Loading Reasoning: The Synergy between Pretraining & Post-Training Data
